name: AgentCore SRE Agent
description: Multi-agent site-reliability assistant from AWS that investigates infrastructure issues using logs, metrics and runbooks.
whatItDoes: SREs describe an incident and specialised agents collaborate to look at Kubernetes state, logs, performance metrics and operational procedures, then report findings. The sample ships with demo backend APIs.
howItWorks: A supervisor coordinates specialist agents whose tools are exposed as MCP tools through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. It runs locally from a CLI or is deployed to AgentCore Runtime, using Amazon Nova or Claude models.

requirements.name: AWS account
requirements.description: Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and model access

requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: Only when calling Anthropic directly instead of Bedrock
